Sam: Morning — quick daybreak ops roundup before I head off at 12:30. TL;DR: roll 3.2 to prod finished last night, embeddings cache TTL change rolled (30m), canary for embed-encoder completed. Watch: embeddings-group-b (eu-west) p95 up ~2-3s vs baseline. No user-facing errors yet. Action items below.
Priya: I can take latency investigation. First look shows more GC on embed-encoder-2, grabbing logs now.
Sam: thanks. If you need restarts: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/embed-encoder -n prod`. Check pods: `kubectl get pods -l app=embed-encoder -n prod -o wide`.
Liam: I'll run the canary healthcheck + perf sweep against canary-v2. Quick test: `curl -sS https://canary.api.redwood-inference/v1/enc -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq .`
Marta: I'll alert CS for the eu-west scheduled jobs and customers with higher SLAs. FYI the TTL change (30m) could raise origin load during morning batch windows.
Sam: Pager coverage update: Priya covers 12:30-18:00. I'm OOTO 12:30-14:30 but reachable for emergencies.
Priya: noted — forwarding alerts to PagerDuty rotation and adding a short note in the runbook.
oncall-bot: Rotation update: Priya now primary (12:30-18:00). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency
Liam: config FYI — batching override is disabled on canary; if throughput drops, re-enable with PATCH /config/batching {"override": false}.
Marta: quick ask — PR #482 (docs + small fix) needs a quick review, @Liam can you peek after canary?
Liam: will take a look after perf checks, ETA ~30m.
Sam: monitoring checklist: check queue depth `redis-cli -h redis-prod-lb llen embedding_queue` — if >500, throttle ingest and inform CS. Also glance at `grafana/dashboard/embeddings` for p95 by region.
Priya: starting tail now, sample snippet: ```embed-encoder-2 stderr: ...GC pause 120ms; mem reclaim; inference thread blocked 90ms...``` will post updates.
Marta: thanks — leaving note in ops-daily: "daybreak: eu-west embed p95 up; Priya investigating; Liam canary checks; Marta contacting CS; Sam OOTO midday swap." :white_check_mark:
